name: Unexpected Code Execution
description: Model-controlled text becomes executable code outside its intended boundary — eval-style APIs fed untrusted content, generated code run without review, or escape from the interpreter sandbox onto the host.
differs: Distinguished from Agentic Tool Misuse (T3.001), where the agent uses a sanctioned tool: here execution happens outside the sanctioned surface entirely.
